## R Markdown

# Load packages
```{r}
library(vegan)
```

# 1. Calculate Bray-Curtis similarity for taxonomic communities

```{r}
design <- read.csv('./Homogenization_analysis/Data/Metadata_Irrigation.manipulative.exper.csv', header = T, row.names = 1)
design.irr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "irrigated")
design.unirr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "non-irrigated")

# Taxonomy
comm <- read.csv('./Homogenization_analysis/Data/Species.count.csv', header = T, row.names = 1)
comm.irr <- comm[,rownames(design.irr)]
comm.irr <- comm.irr[rowSums(comm.irr)>0,]
comm.unirr <- comm[,rownames(design.unirr)]
comm.unirr <- comm.unirr[rowSums(comm.unirr)>0,]

# Calculate Bray-Curtis dissimilarity
comm <- t(comm[,rownames(design)])
dim(comm)
bc_dist <- 1 - vegdist(comm, method = "bray")

# As factor
design$Irrigation <- as.factor(design$Irrigation)

# Retrieve the “Irrigation” group
groups <- design$Irrigation
unique_groups <- levels(groups)

# Initialize the results list
bc_means <- numeric(length(unique_groups))
names(bc_means) <- unique_groups

# Calculate the mean Bray-Curtis distance within each group
for (group in unique_groups) {
  # Extract a sample from the current group
  group_samples <- rownames(comm)[design$Irrigation == group]
  
  # Extract the distance submatrix of samples within a group
  if (length(group_samples) > 1) {    # Ensure that there are at least two samples in the group.
    group_dist <- as.matrix(bc_dist)[group_samples, group_samples]
    
    # Remove only the triangular matrix (excluding the diagonal and duplicate values)
    group_dist_lower <- group_dist[lower.tri(group_dist)]
    
    # Mean value
    bc_means[group] <- mean(group_dist_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    bc_means[group] <- NA
  }
}


print(bc_means)
# Bray:   irr, 0.674,   unirr, 0.581,  16% higher
```


# Plot taxonomic homogenization

```{r}
#  Initialize a data frame to store the distance values for all groups
dist_data <- data.frame(Distance = numeric(), Irrigation = character())

# Calculate the lower triangular distance for each group
for (group in unique_groups) {
  # Calculate the lower triangular distance for each group
  group_samples <- rownames(comm)[design$Irrigation == group]
  
  if (length(group_samples) > 1) {
    group_dist <- as.matrix(bc_dist)[group_samples, group_samples]
    group_dist_lower <- group_dist[lower.tri(group_dist)]
    group_dist_df <- data.frame(
      Distance = group_dist_lower,
      Irrigation = group
    )
    dist_data <- rbind(dist_data, group_dist_df)
  }
}

head(dist_data)


library(ggplot2)
colors <- c("irrigated"="#4169B2", "non-irrigated"="#BB2BA0")

range(dist_data$Distance)
p1 <- ggplot(dist_data, aes(x = Irrigation, y = Distance, fill = Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.6, size= 0.3, alpha= 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.13, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 2, width = 0.08, alpha= 0.5) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Bray-Curtis similarity") +
theme_bw() + scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
theme(axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 21),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 21),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.border = element_rect(color="black", size=1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + 
  ylim(0.289, 0.834) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.834, label = "P = 0.001", size = 8)

p1
ggsave("./Homogenization_analysis/Output/Taxonomic Homogenization_Bray-Curtis_Manipulative.pdf", p1, width = 4.7, height = 5)


# Statistical test
t.test(Distance ~ Irrigation, data = dist_data)  # t = 3.4238, df = 44.05, p-value = 0.001346
```

# 3. Calculate jaccard similarity for taxonomic communities

```{r}
design <- read.csv('./Homogenization_analysis/Data/Metadata_Irrigation.manipulative.exper.csv', header = T, row.names = 1)
design.irr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "irrigated")
design.unirr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "non-irrigated")

# Taxonomy
comm <- read.csv('./Homogenization_analysis/Data/Species.count.csv', header = T, row.names = 1)
comm.irr <- comm[,rownames(design.irr)]
comm.irr <- comm.irr[rowSums(comm.irr)>0,]
comm.unirr <- comm[,rownames(design.unirr)]
comm.unirr <- comm.unirr[rowSums(comm.unirr)>0,]

# Calculate Bray-Curtis dissimilarity
comm <- t(comm[,rownames(design)])
dim(comm)
bc_dist <- 1 - vegdist(comm, method = "jac", binary = F)

# As factor
design$Irrigation <- as.factor(design$Irrigation)

# Retrieve the “Irrigation” group
groups <- design$Irrigation
unique_groups <- levels(groups)

# Initialize the results list
bc_means <- numeric(length(unique_groups))
names(bc_means) <- unique_groups

# Calculate the mean Bray-Curtis distance within each group
for (group in unique_groups) {
  # Extract a sample from the current group
  group_samples <- rownames(comm)[design$Irrigation == group]
  
  # Extract the distance submatrix of samples within a group
  if (length(group_samples) > 1) {    # Ensure that there are at least two samples in the group.
    group_dist <- as.matrix(bc_dist)[group_samples, group_samples]
    
    # Remove only the triangular matrix (excluding the diagonal and duplicate values)
    group_dist_lower <- group_dist[lower.tri(group_dist)]
    
    # Mean value
    bc_means[group] <- mean(group_dist_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    bc_means[group] <- NA
  }
}


print(bc_means)
# Bray:   irr, 0.511,   unirr, 0.425,  20.2% higher
```
